title: Dynamic Link Prediction with Temporally Enhanced Signed Graph Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.26290v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Temporal signed networks (TSNs) model the time evolution of cooperative and adversarial relationships that arise in applications such as social media analysis, trust and reputation systems, and financial transaction networks. While graph neural networks (GNNs) perform well for static or unsigned link prediction, effective learning in temporal signed graphs remains challenging due to the interaction of signed relations, evolving structure, and balance-theoretic constraints. To address this gap, we propose a \emph{modular} temporal enhancement framework for signed GNNs that integrates historical context into otherwise static architectures. The framework introduces a Historical Context Integration Module (HCIM) that combines learnable recency-aware temporal weighting, LSTM-based embedding trajectory modeling, and multi-head temporal attention to capture both short- and long-term signed interaction dynamics. translated_title: 基于时间增强符号图神经网络的动态链路预测
translated_abstract: 时间符号网络（TSNs）对社交网络分析、信任与声誉系统以及金融交易网络等应用中合作与对抗关系的时间演化进行建模。虽然图神经网络（GNNs）在静态或无符号链路预测中表现良好，但由于符号关系、演化结构与平衡理论约束之间的相互作用，在时间符号图中进行有效学习仍然具有挑战性。为解决这一空白，我们提出了一种用于符号GNN的模块化时间增强框架，将历史上下文整合到原本静态的架构中。该框架引入了历史上下文集成模块（HCIM），结合了可学习的近因感知时间加权、基于LSTM的嵌入轨迹建模以及多头时间注意力，以捕捉短期和长期的符号交互动态。历史信息被融合（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种模块化的时间增强框架，通过历史上下文集成模块（HCIM）融合可学习的近因感知时间加权、LSTM嵌入轨迹建模与多头时间注意力，将历史信息注入静态符号图神经网络，从而提升时间符号网络中的动态链路预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular temporal enhancement framework for signed GNNs, introducing a Historical Context Integration Module (HCIM) that combines learnable recency-aware temporal weighting, LSTM-based embedding trajectory modeling, and multi-head temporal attention to improve dynamic link prediction in temporal signed networks.
